title: Tier 0 + Tier 1 Filtering (Greenhouse Gate + Rule Registry)

summary.goal: Implement the first two filtering tiers of the cultivate pipeline. Tier 0 (Greenhouse Gate): keyword-based filtering using greenhouse keyword_require and keyword_exclude lists — signals must match at least one required keyword (if list non-empty) and must not match any excluded keyword. Tier 1 (Rule Registry): a registry of deterministic FilterRule functions with default rules (noise_reject, bot_reject, length_check, specificity_boost, structure_boost, question_boost). Rules are Tuner-managed (enable/disable per greenhouse) with effectiveness tracking (signals_matched count, false_positive_rate). Tier 1 also respects tier1_strictness from CultivateConfig.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tier 0: signal with greenhouse keyword_require=['auth','login'] passes if body contains 'auth' or 'login' (case-insensitive)
Tier 0: signal with greenhouse keyword_exclude=['spam','test'] is rejected if body contains 'spam' or 'test'
Tier 0: empty keyword_require means all signals pass (no require filter)
Tier 1: noise_reject rejects signals with less than 20 characters
Tier 1: bot_reject rejects signals where author_type is 'bot'
Tier 1: length_check rejects signals shorter than configurable minimum
Tier 1: boost rules (specificity_boost, structure_boost, question_boost) add score hints, do not reject
Tier 1: disabled rules are skipped
Tier 1: effectiveness tracking increments signals_matched on each rule execution
Tier 1: tier1_strictness from config determines rejection threshold for aggregate rule scoring
Rejected signals throw SignalFilteredError with filter_tier, rule_name, and reason

steps.title: Implement Tier 0 greenhouse keyword gate
steps.description: Create src/filters/greenhouse-gate.ts. Implement applyGreenhouseGate(signal: {title, body}, greenhouse: {keyword_require, keyword_exclude}): { passed: boolean, reason?: string }. Logic: if keyword_require is non-empty, check that title+body contains at least one required keyword (case-insensitive substring match). Then check that title+body does not contain any excluded keyword. Return {passed: false, reason} on failure, {passed: true} on success. Throw SignalFilteredError(filter_tier=0, reason) on rejection for pipeline integration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Empty keyword_require passes all signals
keyword_require=['auth'] matches 'Authentication flow' (case-insensitive)
keyword_exclude=['test'] rejects 'This is a test message'
Returns clear reason string on rejection

steps.title: Define FilterRule interface and registry
steps.description: Create src/filters/rule-registry.ts. Define FilterRuleFunction type: (signal: NormalizedEvent, config: { tier1_strictness: number }) => FilterRuleResult. FilterRuleResult type: { action: 'pass' | 'reject' | 'boost', score_adjustment?: number, reason?: string }. Implement FilterRuleRegistry class with: register(id, name, description, type, fn), get(id), list(), execute(signal, enabledRuleIds, config) — runs all enabled rules in order, collects results. A single 'reject' action from any rule rejects the signal. Boost actions accumulate score_adjustment.

acceptance_criteria.description: Registry stores rule functions by id
execute() runs only rules whose ids are in enabledRuleIds
A reject from any rule short-circuits and returns rejection
Boost score_adjustments are accumulated and returned in result

steps.title: Implement default filter rules
steps.description: Create src/filters/default-rules.ts. Implement and register 6 default rules: noise_reject (reject if title+body combined < 20 chars), bot_reject (reject if author_type === 'bot'), length_check (reject if body < configurable min length based on tier1_strictness), specificity_boost (boost +0.1 if body contains specific technical terms, code snippets, or URLs), structure_boost (boost +0.05 if body has structured formatting: bullet points, numbered lists, headers), question_boost (boost +0.1 if body contains question patterns: '?', 'how to', 'why does', 'what if'). Export a registerDefaultRules(registry) function.

acceptance_criteria.description: noise_reject rejects 'hi' (< 20 chars)
bot_reject rejects signals from author_type='bot'
specificity_boost gives +0.1 for signals with URLs or code
question_boost gives +0.1 for signals containing '?'
All 6 rules registered via registerDefaultRules()

steps.title: Add Tuner-managed enable/disable
steps.description: Extend the rule execution path to respect CultivateConfig.filter_rules settings. In the pipeline's Tier 1 execution: load current CultivateConfig from storage, extract enabled rule IDs from config.filter_rules (rules where enabled=true), pass only enabled IDs to registry.execute(). If no config exists, all default rules are enabled. Also read tier1_strictness from config (default 0.5) and pass to rule functions that use it (e.g., length_check threshold scales with strictness).

acceptance_criteria.description: Disabled rules are not executed
tier1_strictness from config is passed to rule functions
Missing config defaults to all rules enabled, strictness 0.5

steps.title: Add effectiveness tracking
steps.description: After each Tier 1 execution, update effectiveness metrics in storage. For each rule that was evaluated: increment signals_matched count. Track rejection outcomes to compute false_positive_rate (signals that were rejected by a rule but later manually re-admitted or linked to a plan — computed lazily, not in real-time). Implement updateRuleEffectiveness(ruleId, matched: boolean) in the filter module, which calls storage.updateEffectiveness(). Add a recalculateFalsePositiveRate(ruleId) function that queries linked/dismissed signal outcomes.

acceptance_criteria.description: signals_matched incremented for each rule evaluated against a signal
recalculateFalsePositiveRate queries signal outcomes to compute rate
Effectiveness data persisted to storage via updateEffectiveness

steps.title: Integrate tiers into pipeline-ready filter function
steps.description: Create src/filters/index.ts that exports a unified applyFilters(signal: NormalizedEvent, greenhouse: Greenhouse, config: CultivateConfig, storage: CultivateStorage): Promise<{ passed: boolean, tier?: 0|1, reason?: string, score_adjustments: number }> function. This runs Tier 0 (greenhouse gate) first, then Tier 1 (rule registry) if Tier 0 passes. Returns aggregated result with score adjustments from boost rules. On rejection, throws SignalFilteredError with the appropriate tier and reason. Also export the registry, greenhouse gate, and individual components for direct use.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tier 0 runs before Tier 1 — Tier 0 rejection skips Tier 1 entirely
Score adjustments from boost rules are accumulated and returned
SignalFilteredError thrown with correct tier (0 or 1) and reason
All filter components exported from src/filters/index.ts
